prose: Bloomberg's analysis says planned and active data center investments in Finland now exceed 67 billion euros, driven by AI demand, a cool climate and access to renewable energy. The article is paywalled, so only the excerpt was available.
The excerpt also mentions TSMC's quarterly revenue rising 51% as AI demand holds up, as a related headline.
highlights: Finland data center investment above EUR 67B
Drivers: AI demand, cool climate, renewable energy
